turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start a little film club with my neighbours. How do I make it not awkward?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Keep it simple at first. Same night every month, someone's living room, and one film everyone agrees on in advance.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Rotate it. Each host picks, which gives everyone a turn and mixes up the genres.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: just go home, or do we talk?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A short chat is the best bit. Ask one easy question, like which character people liked most. It gets everyone talking without feeling like homework.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ask everyone to bring something. It lowers the cost for the host and makes it feel shared.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll put a note through the doors this weekend.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely. Include a date and your film pick, so people have something concrete to say yes to.
